[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Honest first-paint benchmarks for the Artifacts panes[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]bench[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bench: build a pane-level first-paint benchmark over a live-scale [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]synthetic corpus and repair the agent-catalog bench, whose fixture [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]structurally omits the two costs that actually dominate the real [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]registry load.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop revalidating the agent-name registry on every load[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]registry[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bench[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]registry: make the process-cached registry stop paying a full [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]source-signature stat sweep and a full per-entry owner-existence sweep [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on every `load_name_registry()` call, which is 905ms of the Agent pane's[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]1529ms load.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Two-stage Agent pane load[/bold #D7AFFF]                                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]agent-paint[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bench[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]agent-paint: paint the Agent pane from a bounded head slice and move the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]full-corpus query-index build into a background extension worker, using [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the shipped Files-pane two-stage pattern.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Direct dict-to-QueryRow corpus construction in sase-core[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-corpus[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bench[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-corpus: remove the serde_json::Value intermediate from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`compile_corpus_with_profile` in the sase-core repo so corpus indexing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stops materializing every row twice on the Rust side, then release and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]raise the floor.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Cut the Python-side corpus marshalling cost[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]entry-projection[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bench[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]entry-projection: stop materializing each query row three times on the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Python side and shrink the per-row projection work in the agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]catalog's query-entry adapter, without changing the row wire shape.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
